rules.statement: A defendant who does not object to the share allotted to him in an interlocutory decree and subsequently appears without contesting his share cannot later challenge the validity of a final decree entered on that interlocutory decree.
rules.supporting_quote: "In spite of the fact that he sent the petition and gave a proxy to Mr. Kularatne 'to file all necessary papers' I find that no further steps were taken in that behalf either by the 1st appellant or by Mr. Kularatne. He was given due notice (see Journal Entry P9 of 8.9.38) of the confirmation of the scheme but did not choose to appear in person or by proctor to support the objection he had taken in P5."
